title: find understand use nonpriority must not block
name: Find understand use nonpriority must not block
rule: Find / understand / use; non-priority must not block findability. Every design decision is judged on those three. Group the same public topic across departments; remove duplicate content. Do not publish what GC is not the authoritative source for — link out instead.

citation.source: Canada.ca — Designing content; Designing content for Canada.ca

pass_when: Non-priority content does not hide the findable task; duplicate public topics are grouped/removed; non-authoritative material is a link out.
fail_when: Extra non-priority blocks findability; duplicate departmental pages for the same public topic; GC publishes what it is not the source for.
overview: Design for find, understand, use; non-priority content must not block findability.
apply_when: Prioritizing Canada.ca topics, duplicates, and what GC should publish.
not_when: Visual polish tasks that do not change findability or authority of content.
agent_hint: Keep non-priority from hiding tasks; group duplicates; link out non-authoritative material.
description: Every Canada.ca design decision is judged on find, understand, and use. Non-priority material must not block findability of the task. Group the same public topic across departments and remove duplicate content. Do not publish what GC is not the authoritative source for — link out instead. Fail extra non-priority that hides the task, duplicate departmental pages for one public topic, or GC publishing material it does not own.
